note.question: How should platforms jointly deploy these two revenue levers?
note.overview: Digital content platforms such as Netflix, Spotify, and YouTube increasingly fund content through a mix of subscription fees and advertising. Most of these platforms offer users only coarse options: a single ad-supported tier, a single paid tier, or a two-tier “free-with-ads versus paid-ad-free” menu. We ask how platforms should jointly deploy these two revenue levers.
